name: collapsible
useFor: Use to tuck away secondary detail on a page (an order's line items, advanced checkout settings). Make the CollapsibleTrigger a row with its name and a CollapsibleChevron. For a list of questions use the accordion.
constraints: Hiding the main content of a page
source: Extension from opencommerce-agentcard-web src/app/globals.css (the questions' slide) and accordion.tsx
title: Collapsible
description: A section that slides open in place under a quiet row with a turning chevron.
